casteCategories.label: General / UR
casteCategories.note: Competes under unreserved rules; no category age relaxation.

casteCategories.label: EWS
casteCategories.note: Reservation benefit applies with valid EWS certificate; no standard age relaxation.

casteCategories.label: OBC / BC (Non-Creamy Layer)
casteCategories.note: Reservation and age relaxation with valid OBC-NCL/BC certificate.

casteCategories.label: SC
casteCategories.note: Reservation, age relaxation, and sometimes lower qualifying marks.

casteCategories.label: ST
casteCategories.note: Reservation, age relaxation, and sometimes lower qualifying marks.

casteCategories.label: PwBD (Disability)
casteCategories.note: Reservation and age relaxation per disability category — combinable with other category relaxation.

casteCategories.label: Ex-Servicemen
casteCategories.note: Relaxation equal to service years plus 3, per recruitment rules.

casteCategories.label: Women
casteCategories.note: May receive horizontal reservation in some state recruitments.
